summary: Almost every Experience bullet names a duty instead of a result and leans on weak verbs ("Responsible for", "Worked with", "Helped"), so the CV shows what Nazar was assigned rather than what changed because of him.

findings.item: Backend Developer (part-time), Kvikk AS   Jun 2025 – present
findings.quote: Responsible for the backend of the ordering system.
findings.why: This states a responsibility, not an outcome. A reader cannot tell whether the backend was reliable, fast, or improved while you owned it.
findings.rewrite: Built and maintained the ordering-system backend, which processes {orders_per_day} orders/day.

needs_from_user.question: Roughly how many orders a day does the ordering system handle?

findings.item: Backend Developer (part-time), Kvikk AS   Jun 2025 – present
findings.quote: Worked with the frontend team on the checkout flow.
findings.why: "Worked with" hides your contribution; the reader cannot tell what you built or decided on the checkout flow.
findings.rewrite: Built the checkout flow's backend with the frontend team, cutting {checkout_metric} by {improvement}.

needs_from_user.question: Which checkout metric did the work improve — errors, abandonment, or latency?
By how much did that metric change (percentage or absolute)?

findings.item: Backend Developer (part-time), Kvikk AS   Jun 2025 – present
findings.why: "Helped maintain" is the weakest possible framing — it places you next to the work, not in charge of it, and names no effect.
findings.rewrite: Maintained the deployment pipeline, reducing failed deploys by {failed_deploy_reduction}.

needs_from_user.question: Did your pipeline work cut failed or slow deploys, and by roughly how much?

findings.quote: Graded assignments and gave written feedback.
findings.why: This is a routine TA duty with no scale. As written it adds little beyond the job title.
findings.rewrite: Marked {assignments_count} assignments a week and wrote individual feedback for each student.

needs_from_user.question: Roughly how many assignments did you grade per week?

findings.why: The gap between employer and dates is three literal spaces rather than a tab or alignment, so it will render unevenly and reads as sloppy next to the other role.
